name: table_quality
method: random.Random(42).sample of 20 of the 929 final report tables; PDF region vs stored grid, labelled by eye (severity rules in scripts/measure/review_table_quality.py, fixed before the review)

severity_rules.high: a reader would get a wrong answer: value under the wrong column or row label, header path naming the wrong year or measure, wrong or missing value
severity_rules.medium: meaning recoverable but degraded: header text truncated or fused, missing column or row label, section or title attached to the wrong rows, while every value keeps its correct label
severity_rules.none: headers, labels and values match the PDF

labels.finding: from the 3rd exposure class on, rows shift: a sub-total is labelled with the next class, several cells hold values of two rows; header lost the date on all but one column; 'Clientele' masked as <PERSON>
spreadsheet replacement stored without header rows: values correct but no column labels (dates, MREL vs TLAC); cause: a one-cell subtitle row after the title stops the header detection
headers correct; first row label fused with the unit 'In millions of euros'
transposed instrument table: data row used as header, values of neighbouring columns fused, later rows shifted by one column
header spans garbled; first value of each row fused into the sector label column, so gross carrying amounts sit under 'Sector/subsector'
values and columns correct; header paths start with a title fragment and the year sits only in the label column
spreadsheet replacement; correct, and adds the year headers the continued PDF page lacks
values correct; 'Approche simplifiée' masked as '<PERSON> simplifiée'; top header 'Expositions pondérées (RWA)' outside the table box
5-row header cut at 4: maturity buckets end up in a data row, and the 'Average weighted maturity' column is labelled as a gross carrying amount
'Somme de 1 à 10' column carries the 'Rang en cas d'insolvabilité' span; rank descriptions and '(plus senior)' read as data rows
values and dates correct; section 'Available own funds (amounts)' absorbed into the header, another section repeated across all columns
leaf headers in a data row and paths shifted: the 'Total nominal' column is labelled 'dont non performantes', the non-performing column has no leaf
'of which SRT' / 'Sub-Total' leaves in a data row; the originator Sub-Total column is labelled 'Institution acts as sponsor'
leaf headers (Average, Minimum, Maximum, End of Year) in a data row; 3 columns without the year; 'Maximum' masked as <PERSON>
spreadsheet replacement, values and headers correct; section rows repeated in every column instead of prefixing the countries under them

notes.pipeline_defect_found: 18 of 107 spreadsheet tables stored without header rows (one-cell subtitle row after the title); fix proposed, not applied
notes.labelled_by: visual review, single reviewer; to be spot-checked by the project owner
